name: SVC_WO_CONNECTIONS
description: This table is used to store connections information for B2B Field Service.  CONNECTION_ID is primary/unique key in this table.

columns.name: CONNECTION_ID
columns.description: An autogenerated number and primary key for the SVC_WO_CONNECTIONS table.

columns.name: CONNECTION_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the type of connection. Valid connection types are ORA_SVC_WO_OFSC and ORA_SVC_WO_OTHER.

columns.name: CONNECTION_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the unique connection code.

columns.name: CONNECTION_NAME
columns.description: Property used to identify the name of the connection.

columns.name: FS_INSTANCE_NAME
columns.description: Property used to identify the instance name required to access Oracle Field Service.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: The user name used for the connection.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if the connection is active.

columns.name: LAST_VERIFIED_DATE
columns.description: Property used to identify the last time the connection was verified.

columns.name: WA_RETRIEVAL_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if the work order area retrieval checks are valid.

columns.name: WA_RETRIEVAL_AVAILABLE_MSG_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the connection message identifying the problem with the connection for the work order area retrieval check.

columns.name: QB_BOOKING_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if the quota based booking checks are valid.

columns.name: QB_BOOKING_AVAILABLE_MSG_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the connection message identifying the problem with the connection for the quota based booking checks.

columns.name: DA_BOOKING_AVAILABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if the direct assignment booking checks are valid.

columns.name: DA_BOOKING_AVAILABLE_MSG_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the connection message identifying the problem with the connection for the direct assignment booking checks.

columns.name: WZONE_RETRIEVAL_AVAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if the work zone retrieval checks are valid.

columns.name: WZONE_RETRIEVAL_AVAIL_MSG_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the connection message identifying the problem with the connection for the work zone retrieval checks.

columns.name: WSKILL_RETRIEVAL_AVAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if the work skill retrieval checks are valid.

columns.name: WSKILL_RETRIEVAL_AVAIL_MSG_CD
columns.description: Property used to identify the connection message identifying the problem with the connection for the work skill retrieval checks.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
